valid_change.name: valid_change
valid_change.value: ("file_changes"."kind" = 'add' AND "file_changes"."before_hash" IS NULL AND "file_changes"."after_hash" IS NOT NULL) OR ("file_changes"."kind" = 'delete' AND "file_changes"."before_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "file_changes"."after_hash" IS NULL) OR ("file_changes"."kind" = 'modify' AND "file_changes"."before_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "file_changes"."after_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "file_changes"."before_hash" != "file_changes"."after_hash")
